name: Storybook
summary: Storybook is the industry standard workshop for building, documenting, and testing UI components in isolation.

agent_entrypoints.what: Agent-oriented docs map: setup per framework, writing stories, testing, addons.
Adds Storybook to an existing project, detecting the framework.
Full documentation when llms.txt is not specific enough.

use_when: You generated several components and the user needs to actually see and compare them.
You want states (loading, empty, error, long text) to be reviewable without clicking through the whole app.
You need a durable home for a design system's documentation.
You want visual or accessibility regressions caught automatically.
avoid_when: It is a one-off prototype that will be deleted this week - the setup cost will not pay back.
The user asked for a static mockup with no build step.

baseline.description: Storybook is the industry standard workshop for building, documenting, and testing UI components in isolation
